title: A Practical Mode-parallel Implementation of the (H-)Tucker Decomposition via Randomization
summary: In the last decades, tensors have emerged as the right tool to represent multidimensional data in a compact yet informative manner. Moreover, it is well-known that by performing low-rank factorizations of such tensors one is often able to effectively unveil possible hidden structure in data, mainly due to unexpected dependencies among the different variables encoded in the given tensor. However, computing these factorizations is extremely energy-consuming and memory-demanding, especially for high-dimensional tensors, namely those with a large number of modes.
